title: Docker Compose rendered configuration holds the value its source only referenced
summary: A Compose file whose environment entry for GITHUB_TOKEN only names a variable (GITHUB_TOKEN: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}), and the canonical configuration that docker compose config prints from it, where the same key holds the resolved credential-shaped literal. The rendered text is a different artifact from the source, with the same keys.
rationale: The source and the rendered configuration describe the same service, and a reader who has learned that a Compose file holds references would treat both as safe. The reference is safe because the value lives outside the file; docker compose config reads that outside value and writes it into its output, which people paste into issues, CI logs and chat to show what Compose will run. Which artifact holds the secret is therefore a property of how the text was produced, not of the key name or the file name. The source side of the pair is covered by the existing reference Cases; this Case is the resolved side. Not claimed: that docker compose config also inlines the contents of env_file files (the --no-env-resolution flag description suggests it, no page states it), the exact layout of --format json or --environment output, and any Compose version boundary.

expectation.rationale: Flagged in the rendered configuration only. Docker documents that docker compose config renders the actual data model, resolving variables in the Compose file, and shows an interpolated value replacing its reference in the printed output; a name-only environment entry resolves to the shell or .env value. GitHub documents the ghp_ prefix for a classic personal access token. A ghp_ literal in the printed configuration is the credential itself. The fixtures use a synthetic value built from an authored description (not issued, deliberately invalid trailing characters); the 36-character body is not provider-documented and is not what this Case asserts. The reference-only source is not flagged and belongs to the existing reference Cases.

sources.supports: docker compose config renders the actual data model to be applied on the Docker Engine. It merges the Compose files set by -f flags, resolves variables in the Compose file, and expands short-notation into the canonical format.

When you run docker compose up, the web service defined in the Compose file interpolates in the image webapp:v1.5 which was set in the .env file. You can verify this with the config command, which prints your resolved application config to the terminal.
sources.locator: intro example (cat .env, cat compose.yaml, docker compose config)

sources.supports: Result 10: The environment attribute in the Compose file is set to replicate VALUE from the local environment. Host OS value takes precedence and is replicated into the container's environment.
GitHub issues tokens that begin with a prefix to indicate the token's type; the table lists Personal access token (classic) with prefix ghp_.

relations.note: Reference-only twin of the same Compose key; the reference side projects that existing Case, this Case is the rendered side whose outcome flips.
